forecast_text: Flows and water levels along the main stem of the Ottawa River are within seasonal values for this time of year. With little to no precipitation received last week and limited amounts forecast over the next few days, flows and levels are expected to remain fairly stable or slightly decrease over the coming week, depending on locations. At some locations, water levels are below navigational chart datums. See the SPECIAL FEATURE section on our Home Page for our summertime message.
